name: Vuelve
author: vuelve

sections.description:
Vuelve connects your store to Vuelve’s messaging platform, enabling:
– Automated WhatsApp cart recovery sequences
– WhatsApp campaigns (manual broadcasts)
– Real-time customer chat from the Vuelve dashboard or mobile app
– Smart event-based automations
– Custom message templates
– Customer segmentation & advanced analytics

Setup takes less than 5 minutes: connect your shop, verify your WhatsApp business number, and start recovering revenue immediately.

Key Features

✔ Cart Recovery Automations
Automatically send personalized WhatsApp messages to customers who abandon checkout.

✔ WhatsApp Campaigns
Create audiences using segmentation and send bulk messages directly from Vuelve.

✔ Live Chat With Customers
Respond to customer messages in real time from the Vuelve dashboard or mobile app.

✔ Easy Template Editor
Create and customize WhatsApp message templates with placeholders such as coupon codes or product details.

✔ Checkout Marketing Consent Checkbox
Adds an optional checkbox at checkout for GDPR-friendly opt-in management.

✔ Customer & Order Sync
The plugin syncs your customers and historic orders securely so you can build segments and run campaigns.

✔ Zero-Code Setup
No coding or developer knowledge required.

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Connect your store to Vuelve through the onboarding wizard.
  3. Choose your WhatsApp number and verify your account.
  4. Enable automations and start recovering revenue automatically.

All communication with Vuelve’s API is secure and GDPR-compliant.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/vuelve/, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Follow instructions, and a setup wizard will appear. Follow the steps to connect your store to Vuelve.
  4. Ensure WooCommerce is active before starting the onboarding process.
sections.faq:
Do I need a WhatsApp Business number?

Yes. During onboarding you can either connect an existing number or choose a new one.

Does this plugin store customer data?

Customer data is synchronized securely to Vuelve solely for the purpose of sending messages and creating audience segments.

Does it work with WooCommerce Blocks checkout?

Yes. The plugin adds a resilient marketing-consent component compatible with the new checkout experience.

Does it affect site speed?

No. The plugin loads only lightweight assets and does not affect frontend performance.
